# SD Fast Notary

> SD Fast Notary is a mobile notary public in San Diego, California, based at 11779 Westview Pkwy, San Diego, CA 92126. It travels to homes, offices, hospitals, care facilities and jails across all of San Diego County, 7 days a week, with same-day appointments often available. Phone/text: (858) 859-1779. Online booking: https://calendly.com/notaryservicesigning

Key facts:
- Business name: SD Fast Notary (also known as San Diego Fast Notary)
- Website: https://sdfastnotary.com
- Phone: +1 858-859-1779 (call or text)
- Address: 11779 Westview Pkwy, San Diego, CA 92126 (Mira Mesa)
- Hours: 7 days a week, by appointment
- Service area: All of San Diego County, including Mira Mesa, Scripps Ranch, Rancho Penasquitos, Carmel Valley, La Jolla, Downtown San Diego, Poway, Escondido, Carlsbad, Oceanside, Chula Vista, El Cajon, La Mesa and Santee
- Reviews: 5.0 stars from 276+ Google reviews for our notary, Pragya Sharma (https://maps.google.com/?cid=4287846694361830860)
- Pricing: $15 per notarized signature (the California legal maximum, Gov. Code 8211) plus a travel fee quoted upfront; loan signings at a flat rate
- Services: mobile notary, loan signing agent, apostille assistance, power of attorney, advance health care directives, deeds, hospital and care facility notary, jail notary, business and legal documents

## Services
- [Mobile Notary](https://sdfastnotary.com/mobile-notary.html): notary comes to you anywhere in San Diego County
- [Loan Signing Agent](https://sdfastnotary.com/loan-signing.html): purchase, refinance, HELOC, reverse mortgage closings
- [Apostille Services](https://sdfastnotary.com/apostille.html): notarization plus California Secretary of State apostille help
- [Hospital & Jail Notary](https://sdfastnotary.com/hospital-jail-notary-san-diego.html): bedside and detention facility visits
- [Service Areas](https://sdfastnotary.com/service-areas.html): 55 neighborhoods and cities served
- [Price Estimator](https://sdfastnotary.com/price-estimator.html): calculate notary fees at $15 per signature
- [Business Notary](https://sdfastnotary.com/business-notary-san-diego.html): on-site office notarizations
- [Senior & Assisted Living Notary](https://sdfastnotary.com/assisted-living-notary-san-diego.html): visits to seniors and care homes
